verses.sloka: महोदरे तु निहते महापार्श्वो महाबलः।सुग्रीवेण समीक्ष्याथ क्रोधात् संरक्तलोचनः।अङ्गदस्य चमूं भीमां क्षोभयामास सायकैः ।। ६.९९.१ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahodare tu nihate mahāpārśvo mahābalaḥ।sugrīveṇa samīkṣyātha krodhāt saṁraktalocanaḥ।aṅgadasya camūṁ bhīmāṁ kṣobhayāmāsa sāyakaiḥ ।। 6.99.1 ।।

translations.english: Gazing at Mahodara killed by Sugriva, mighty Mahaparsva's eyes turned red in anger. He created a commotion in the army of Angada.
translations.hindi: दहिनी सुजा, जो उसका बड़ा महारा थी, काट डालो विभा- षण ओर हनुमान्‌ ने भो इस लड़ाई में बड़ा काम किआ

verses.sloka: स वानराणां मुख्यानामुत्तमाङ्गानि सर्वशः।पातयामास कायेभ्यः फलं वृन्तादिवानिलः ।। ६.९९.२ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vānarāṇāṁ mukhyānāmuttamāṅgāni sarvaśaḥ।pātayāmāsa kāyebhyaḥ phalaṁ vṛntādivānilaḥ ।। 6.99.2 ।।

translations.english: That leader (Mahaparsva) severed the heads of Vanara leaders from their body just as wind drops fruits from stalks.

verses.sloka: केषाञ्चिदिषुभिर्बाहून् स्कन्धांश्चिच्छेद राक्षसः।वानराणां सुसङ्क्रुद्धः पार्श्वं केषां व्यदारयत् ।। ६.९९.३ ।।
verses.transliteration: keṣāñcidiṣubhirbāhūn skandhāṁściccheda rākṣasaḥ।vānarāṇāṁ susaṅkruddhaḥ pārśvaṁ keṣāṁ vyadārayat ।। 6.99.3 ।।

translations.english: Then with his arrows, that Rakshasa (Mahaparsva) shattered the arms of some, shoulders of some, sides, and ribs of some Vanaras.

verses.sloka: ते ऽर्दिता बाणवर्षेण महापार्श्वेन वानराः।विषादविमुखाः सर्वे बभूवुर्गतचेतसः ।। ६.९९.४ ।।
verses.transliteration: te 'rditā bāṇavarṣeṇa mahāpārśvena vānarāḥ।viṣādavimukhāḥ sarve babhūvurgatacetasaḥ ।। 6.99.4 ।।

translations.english: By the rain of arrows of Mahaparsva, the Vanaras were dejected and wore a sad look on their face and lost senses.

verses.sloka: निरीक्ष्य बलमुद्विग्नमङ्गदो राक्षसार्दितम्।वेगं चक्रे महाबाहुः समुद्र इव पर्वणि ।। ६.९९.५ ।।
verses.transliteration: nirīkṣya balamudvignamaṅgado rākṣasārditam।vegaṁ cakre mahābāhuḥ samudra iva parvaṇi ।। 6.99.5 ।।

translations.english: Observing the army oppressed by the Rakshasa leader, Angada, endowed with broad shoulders, exhibited his might speedily like the ocean on full moon days.

verses.sloka: आयसं परिघं गृह्य सूर्यरश्मिसमप्रभम्।समरे वानरश्रेष्ठो महापार्श्वे न्यपातयत् ।। ६.९९.६ ।।
verses.transliteration: āyasaṁ parighaṁ gṛhya sūryaraśmisamaprabham।samare vānaraśreṣṭho mahāpārśve nyapātayat ।। 6.99.6 ।।

translations.english: The foremost of the Vanaras (Angada), taking an iron bar flung on Mahaparsva in the battlefield.

verses.sloka: स तु तेन प्रहारेण महापार्श्वो विचेतनः।ससूतः स्यन्दनात्तस्माद्विसञ्ज्ञः प्रापतद्भुवि ।। ६.९९.७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu tena prahāreṇa mahāpārśvo vicetanaḥ।sasūtaḥ syandanāttasmādvisañjñaḥ prāpatadbhuvi ।। 6.99.7 ।।

translations.english: By that hit, Mahaparsva became unconscious and fell on the ground, senseless, from the chariot along with the charioteer.

verses.sloka: सर्क्षराजस्तु तेजस्वी नीलाञ्जनचयोपमः।निष्पत्य सुमहावीर्यः स्वाद्व्यूहान्मेघसन्निभात् ।। ६.९९.८ ।।
verses.transliteration: sarkṣarājastu tejasvī nīlāñjanacayopamaḥ।niṣpatya sumahāvīryaḥ svādvyūhānmeghasannibhāt ।। 6.99.8 ।।

translations.english: Jambavantha, the mighty king of Bears, rushed from his army that looked like a dark cloud. The great hero with his army resembling a heap of black mountain, in his fury seized a huge rock resembling a mountain peak, crushed the chariot and struck the horses.

verses.sloka: प्रगृह्य गिरिशृङ्गाभां क्रुद्धः सुविपुलां शिलाम्।अश्वान् जघान तरसा स्यन्दनं च बभञ्ज तम् ।। ६.९९.९ ।।
verses.transliteration: pragṛhya giriśṛṅgābhāṁ kruddhaḥ suvipulāṁ śilām।aśvān jaghāna tarasā syandanaṁ ca babhañja tam ।। 6.99.9 ।।

translations.english: Jambavantha, the mighty king of Bears, rushed from his army that looked like a dark cloud. The great hero with his army resembling a heap of black mountain, in his fury seized a huge rock resembling a mountain peak, crushed the chariot and struck the horses.

verses.sloka: मुहूर्ताल्लब्धसञ्ज्ञस्तु महापार्श्वो महाबलः।अङ्गदं बहुभिर्बाणैर्भूयस्तं प्रत्यविध्यत ।। ६.९९.१० ।।
verses.transliteration: muhūrtāllabdhasañjñastu mahāpārśvo mahābalaḥ।aṅgadaṁ bahubhirbāṇairbhūyastaṁ pratyavidhyata ।। 6.99.10 ।।

translations.english: In a short while, regaining consciousness, mighty Mahaparsva struck Angada again with many shafts.

verses.sloka: जाम्बवन्तं त्रिभिर्बाणैराजघान स्तनान्तरे।ऋक्षराजं गवाक्षं च जघान बहुभिः शरैः ।। ६.९९.११ ।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ tribhirbāṇairājaghāna stanāntare।ṛkṣarājaṁ gavākṣaṁ ca jaghāna bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ।। 6.99.11 ।।

translations.english: Mahaparsva pierced three shafts into the chest of Jambavantha and attacked Gavaksha with many arrows.

verses.sloka: जाम्बवन्तं गवाक्षं च स दृष्ट्वा शरपीडितौ।जग्राह परिघं घोरमङ्गदः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।। ६.९९.१२ ।।
verses.transliteration: jāmbavantaṁ gavākṣaṁ ca sa dṛṣṭvā śarapīḍitau।jagrāha parighaṁ ghoramaṅgadaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।। 6.99.12 ।।

translations.english: Seeing Gavaksha and Jambavantha afflicted by shafts, deluded with anger, Angada took hold of a dreadful iron bar.

verses.sloka: तस्याङ्गदः प्रकुपितो राक्षसस्य तमायसम्।दूरस्थितस्य परिघं रविरश्मिसमप्रभम् ।। ६.९९.१३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasyāṅgadaḥ prakupito rākṣasasya tamāyasam।dūrasthitasya parighaṁ raviraśmisamaprabham ।। 6.99.13 ।।

translations.english: Vali's son Angada got enraged, seized an iron bar which shone like the radiant sun's rays and stood at a distance to kill Mahaparsva. Angada whirling the iron bar round and round hurled it around and thrown at Mahaparsva.

verses.sloka: द्वाभ्यां भुजाभ्यां सङ्गृह्य भ्रामयित्वा च वेगवान्।महापार्श्वस्य चिक्षेप वधार्थं वालिनः सुतः ।। ६.९९.१४ ।।
verses.transliteration: dvābhyāṁ bhujābhyāṁ saṅgṛhya bhrāmayitvā ca vegavān।mahāpārśvasya cikṣepa vadhārthaṁ vālinaḥ sutaḥ ।। 6.99.14 ।।

translations.english: Vali's son Angada got enraged, seized an iron bar which shone like the radiant sun's rays and stood at a distance to kill Mahaparsva. Angada whirling the iron bar round and round hurled it around and thrown at Mahaparsva.

verses.sloka: स तु क्षिप्तो बलवता परिघस्तस्य रक्षसः।धनुश्च सशरं हस्ताच्छिरस्त्रं चाप्यपातयत् ।। ६.९९.१५ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu kṣipto balavatā parighastasya rakṣasaḥ।dhanuśca saśaraṁ hastācchirastraṁ cāpyapātayat ।। 6.99.15 ।।

translations.english: That iron bar hurled by Angada hit the forehead of the Rakshasa.

verses.sloka: तं समासाद्य वेगेन वालिपुत्रः प्रतापवान्।तलेनाभ्यहनत् क्रुद्धः कर्णमूले सकुण्डले ।। ६.९९.१६ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ samāsādya vegena vāliputraḥ pratāpavān।talenābhyahanat kruddhaḥ karṇamūle sakuṇḍale ।। 6.99.16 ।।

translations.english: Courageous son of Vali, enraged, with all speed, slapped the Rakshasa's ear adorned with shining earrings, with his palm.
translations.hindi: हो रात्रेस्रिभिर्वीरः कथञ्चि द्विनिपातितः । निरमित्रः कृतोऽस्म्यय नियास्यति हि रावणः

verses.sloka: स तु क्रुद्धो महावेगो महापार्श्वो महाद्युतिः।करेणैकेन जग्राह सुमहान्तं परश्वधम् ।। ६.९९.१७ ।।
verses.transliteration: sa tu kruddho mahāvego mahāpārśvo mahādyutiḥ।kareṇaikena jagrāha sumahāntaṁ paraśvadham ।। 6.99.17 ।।

translations.english: Angry Mahaparsva, who was endowed with speed and shining brightly, took hold of an extraordinary battle axe in one hand.

verses.sloka: तं तैलधौतं विमलं शैलसारमयं दृढम्।राक्षसः परमक्रुद्धो वालिपुत्रे न्यपातयत् ।। ६.९९.१८ ।।
verses.transliteration: taṁ tailadhautaṁ vimalaṁ śailasāramayaṁ dṛḍham।rākṣasaḥ paramakruddho vāliputre nyapātayat ।। 6.99.18 ।।

translations.english: Extremely enraged Rakshasa, hurled at Vali's son that axe that was cleansed with oil, the clean strong axe that was like feet of a mountain.

verses.sloka: तेन वामांसफलके भृशं प्रत्यवपादितम्।अङ्गदो मोक्षयामास सरोषः स परश्वधम् ।। ६.९९.१९ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena vāmāṁsaphalake bhṛśaṁ pratyavapāditam।aṅgado mokṣayāmāsa saroṣaḥ sa paraśvadham ।। 6.99.19 ।।

translations.english: Angada, full of fury, escaped Mahaparsva's aim to strike his left shoulder blade in violence.

verses.sloka: स वीरो वज्रसङ्काशमङ्गदो मुष्टिमात्मनः।संवर्तयत् सुसङ्क्रुद्धः पितुस्तुल्यपराक्रमः ।। ६.९९.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: sa vīro vajrasaṅkāśamaṅgado muṣṭimātmanaḥ।saṁvartayat susaṅkruddhaḥ pitustulyaparākramaḥ ।। 6.99.20 ।।

translations.english: Angada, who was equal to his father in his prowess, was highly furious and himself clenched his fist which resembled thunderbolt.
translations.hindi: फिर श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने प्रसन्न हो और मुषेण को बुला कर उनसे कहा--हे महाप्राज्ञ ! मित्रवत्सल लक्ष्मण जी बाणाँ की चोट से पीड़ित हैं

verses.sloka: राक्षसस्य स्तनाभ्याशे मर्मज्ञो हृदयं प्रति।इन्द्राशनिसमस्पर्शं स मुष्टिं विन्यपातयत् ।। ६.९९.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasasya stanābhyāśe marmajño hṛdayaṁ prati।indrāśanisamasparśaṁ sa muṣṭiṁ vinyapātayat ।। 6.99.21 ।।

translations.english: Angada who knew the vital parts, pierced into the middle of the breasts of the Rakshasa into the heart by his fist which was equal to Indra's thunderbolt.
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी--सुषैण श्रीरामचन्द्र जी की सेना के एक वानरयूथपति चे | वह लंका के राजवैद्य न थे | जैसा कि उनके सम्बन्ध में एक प्रवाद अचलित है । इस सगं का श्लोक २३ देखो |] यथा भवति सुस्वस्थस्तथा त्वं २समुपाचर । विशल्यः क्रियतां क्षित्रे सौमित्रिः सविभीषणः

verses.sloka: तेन तस्य निपातेन राक्षसस्य महामृधे।पफाल हृदयं चाशु स पपात हतो भुवि ।। ६.९९.२२ ।।
verses.transliteration: tena tasya nipātena rākṣasasya mahāmṛdhe।paphāla hṛdayaṁ cāśu sa papāta hato bhuvi ।। 6.99.22 ।।

translations.english: In that great conflict, struck by the fist, the Rakshasa (Mahaparsva's) heart broke and killed and fell on the ground.
translations.hindi: रीछों और वानरों की सेनाओं के पेड़ों से लड़ने वाले, जो वीर तथा अन्य योद्धा तीरों से घायल हो गए हें

verses.sloka: तस्मिन्निपतिते भूमौ तत् सैन्यं सम्प्रचुक्षुभे।अभवच्च महान् क्रोधः समरे रावणस्य तु ।। ६.९९.२३ ।।
verses.transliteration: tasminnipatite bhūmau tat sainyaṁ sampracukṣubhe।abhavacca mahān krodhaḥ samare rāvaṇasya tu ।। 6.99.23 ।।

translations.english: Mahaparsva having fallen down in the battle, the army was bewildered, and Ravana was overcome with anger.
translations.hindi: उन सब को भी यत्नपूर्वक तुम चंगा कर दो। जब महात्मा श्रीरामचन्द्र जी ने बानरय॒थपति सुषेण से इस प्रकार कहा

verses.sloka: वानराणां च हृष्टानां सिंहनादश्च पुष्कलः।स्फोटयन्निव शब्देन लङ्कां साट्टालगोपुराम् ।। ६.९९.२४ ।।
verses.transliteration: vānarāṇāṁ ca hṛṣṭānāṁ siṁhanādaśca puṣkalaḥ।sphoṭayanniva śabdena laṅkāṁ sāṭṭālagopurām ।। 6.99.24 ।।

translations.english: Highly rejoiced Vanaras roared in high pitch sound. The tall attics and gates of Lanka vibrated with sound. Even the gods, accompanied by Indra, made great sounds.
translations.hindi: तब सुषेण ने लक्ष्मण को एक उत्तम ओषधि का नास दिआ । उसको सूं घते ही लक्ष्मण जी के घावों में जो बाणों की नोंके गढी हुई थीं, वे अपने आप बाहिर निकल पड़ीं

verses.sloka: महेन्द्रेणेव देवानां नादः समभवन्महान् ।। ६.९९.२५ ।।
verses.transliteration: mahendreṇeva devānāṁ nādaḥ samabhavanmahān ।। 6.99.25 ।।

translations.english: Highly rejoiced Vanaras roared in high pitch sound. The tall attics and gates of Lanka vibrated with sound. Even the gods, accompanied by Indra, made great sounds.
translations.hindi: सारे घाव पुर गए और पीड़ा भी दूर हो गई । तदनन्तर सुषेण ने श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के आज्ञानुसार दिभीषण प्रमुख, "हितै- षियों का तथा समस्त मुख्य मुख्य वानरों की भी चिकित्सा की

verses.sloka: अथेन्द्रशत्रुस्त्रिदिवालयानां वनौकसां चैव महाप्रणादम्।श्रुत्वा सरोषं युधि राक्षसेन्द्रः पुनश्च युद्धाभिमुखो ऽवतस्थे ।। ६.९९.२६ ।।
verses.transliteration: athendraśatrustridivālayānāṁ vanaukasāṁ caiva mahāpraṇādam।śrutvā saroṣaṁ yudhi rākṣasendraḥ punaśca yuddhābhimukho 'vatasthe ।। 6.99.26 ।।

translations.english: Hearing that great roar of the dwellers of heaven and of the forest-dwelling monkeys, the lord of rakshasas, the enemy of Indra, wrathfully took his stand facing the battle once more.
translations.hindi: उस चिकित्सा से उन सब के शरीरा में धँसे हुए बाण निकल गए, घाव पुर गए और पीड़ा दूर हो गई। वे सब स्वस्थ हो - १ नस्तः-नासिकयाँ ( गो० ) १००८ युद्धकाण्डे गए । क्षण भर में सारी वेदना दूर हो जाने से लक्ष्मण जी हर्षित हुए

verses.sloka: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमद्युद्धकाण्डे एकोनशततमः सर्गः ।। ९९ ।।
verses.transliteration: ityārṣe śrīmadrāmāyaṇe vālmīkīye ādikāvye śrīmadyuddhakāṇḍe ekonaśatatamaḥ sargaḥ ।। 99 ।।

translations.hindi: लक्ष्मण जी को चंगे हो कर उठ बैठते देख, समस्त वानरी सेना सहित श्रीरामचन्द्र जी, वानरराज सुग्रीव, राक्षसराज बिभी- बण ओर ऋषचपति जाम्बबान्‌ बहुत देर तक आनन्द मनाते रहे
